accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The frontier and certificate claims are conditional on the stated finite Gaussian, finite-scenario, null-boundary-closed regime and do not assert global statewise HJB uniqueness.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The PDE uniqueness theorem assumes Hölder-continuous value data, and the discrete-to-PDE convergence theorem assumes the same regularity.
Theorem 1 supplies a further-subsequence joint score/allocation-process representation; Theorem 3 concerns the paper's in-sample welfare-regret functional.
Weak-signal sequential Markov experiments with a Lipschitz limiting sampling function converge to the controlled score-clock diffusion for bounded continuous functionals.
The paper constructs finite-horizon single-arm binary e-value designs by dynamic programming over the current e-value and a discretized e-space.
